Republic of the Philippines
Province of Valenzuela
City of Valenzuela
Sangguniang Panlungsod

RESOLUTION NO. 2026-0118

Series of 2026

A RESOLUTION URGING ALL DEPARTMENT HEADS AND OFFICIALS OF THE CITY GOVERNMENT OF VALENZUELA TO COMPLY WITH THE FULL DISCLOSURE OF STATEMENTS OF ASSETS, LIABILITIES, AND NET WORTH (SALN) AS REQUIRED UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6713, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CODE OF CONDUCT AND ETHICAL STANDARDS FOR PUBLIC OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES

Author: Hon. Patricia Mae Garcia
Reference: SP-2026-0118-RES

WHEREAS, Republic Act No. 6713, otherwise known as the "Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees," requires all public officials and employees to file their Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) annually;

WHEREAS, Section 8 of R.A. 6713 provides that the heads of departments, bureaus, agencies, and instrumentalities including government-owned and controlled corporations shall ensure that all officials and employees under them file their SALN;

WHEREAS, the Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism and other transparency advocates have emphasized the importance of full compliance with SALN requirements for good governance;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, as it is hereby resolved by the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Valenzuela in regular session assembled, to urge and direct all department heads and officials of the City Government of Valenzuela to ensure full compliance with the filing of Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) for the year ending December 31, 2025;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that a copy of this Resolution be furnished to all department heads, office chiefs, and officials concerned for their information, guidance, and compliance.

APPROVED this 10th day of February, 2026.

CERTIFIED TRUE AND CORRECT:

Attested by:
City Council Secretary
